scope: Real GenAI responses and signed-in APEX evidence flows for the expanded public summary dataset on the existing temporary ADB Serverless instance
artifact_identity_note: Artifact hashes identify the candidate files used in this acceptance. A later commit recording these same artifacts does not imply an additional execution.
artifact_hash_basis: SHA-256 of UTF-8 file bytes with CRLF normalized to LF, matching Git's published text normalization. This changes line endings only, not executable content. The application export embeds the same normalized JavaScript and CSS source assets.

application_update.method: Reimported the regenerated engine-generated export into the existing verified lab application
application_update.backup_note: The complete previous app export was retained in a private database table. A DBMS_OUTPUT-only backup was not relied on because that display was truncated.

checks: Preserved the distinction between reported operational changes and projected savings
Did not infer Australian availability from the supplied material

citation_parser_regression.initial_observation: The model returned citation objects; the previous parser marked the answer PARTIAL.
citation_parser_regression.method: Re-read the same saved native and browser Casey answers after replacing the provenance package, including a full browser reload. No replacement model inference was needed to repair citation matching.
citation_parser_regression.additional_browser_observation: The later Casey response used citation objects containing passage_id and exact_summary_text. The final bounded parser accepts explicit id, passage_id or evidence_id fields and preserves malformed or ambiguous entries as partial rather than inventing matches.
